summary: Loads a mesh/animation file a2 into an output struct. Zeros the struct, normalizes the file name, validates it against the off_5DC050 extension table, attempts a direct open, then searches the registered path directory list (dword_8B8E30 entries of stride 132 starting at byte_8B5A3C), and finally walks the MAS linked-animation list (dword_8B8F14). The located file is handed to MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader; each failure mode reports a specific error string and returns -1, while a successfully loaded mesh returns 0.

local_names.v2: open handle from direct open attempt
local_names.v7: open handle from a path-directory attempt
local_names.v8: copy of the path-directory open handle
local_names.v10: MAS node counter / sentinel match value

operations.description: Zero the entire output struct: dwords at this+0x0 through this+0x18 and the byte at this+0x1C (this[28] = 0).
Copy a2 into a local buffer and normalize it via sub_589901, then validate the file type against the off_5DC050 table with sub_587C20(SrcStr, &off_5DC050).

If the normalized name is empty or the extension check fails, format the aIllegalMeshFil message "Illegal mesh file name %s" through StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, report it via sub_53C590(-1, message), and return -1.
Attempt a direct open of the file with sub_587DB0(SrcStr, aRb) using the binary-read mode string.

Direct-open success path: call MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader(v2, 0); on success close the handle via FileCloseWithLock and return 0; on failure report "Error loading animation file %s" (aErrorLoadingAn) and fall through to the shared error exit.

When the direct open fails, search the dword_8B8E30 registered path directories beginning at byte_8B5A3C (entry stride 132): format each candidate path with aSS_3 ("%s\\%s"), open it via sub_587DB0(v13, aRb), and stop at the first success or when the directory count is exhausted.

When a path-directory open succeeds, call MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader(v7, 0); on failure close the handle and report "Error loading animation file %s" (aErrorLoadingAn); on success close the handle and continue.

If the file was not located in any path directory (v5 == dword_8B8E30), walk the MAS linked-animation list headed by dword_8B8F14: iterate while sub_560230(SrcStr) matches, advancing via the +304 link, then call MeshVertexIndexBufferLoader(entry + 16, entry); failure reports "Error loading MAS animation file %s" (aErrorLoadingMa).

If no MAS candidate was found (v10 == dword_8B6AC0), format the aCouldNotLocate_0 message "Could not locate mesh file %s" via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck; otherwise return 0 for the successful load.
On any load error, report the accumulated message via sub_53C590(-1, message) and return -1.
